title: Heartleaf grass, golden path and pale paving terrain tiles
creator: Softmax / Polyworld contributors, with Codex and built-in imagegen

reference.role: User-provided visual material reference; not bundled or relicensed

process: Reconstruct full-coverage grass, path and paving materials in one 3x3 color atlas from the user reference.
Half-offset each 418x418 cell with wrapping, then prepare a feathered center-cross guide.
Imagegen repairs the center crosses at 1254x1254; masked compositing restores all protected source pixels.
Apply periodic boundary correction with a 24-pixel source band; keep the offset orientation as master.
Imagegen infers physical relief aligned to the final color master; make height opaque grayscale and repair edges with an 8-pixel band.
Export named color and height pairs once at 256x256, preserving matched opposite edges.

validation.nimCheck: Passed for terrain.nim and test_terrains.nim with Nim 2.2.6
validation.pairedExport: Passed size, opacity, edge equality, grayscale and PNG round-trip checks for all nine pairs
validation.visualReview: Inspected full source sheets and 2x2 repeated previews of every exported color and height tile
validation.runtimeRender: Not tested in the game engine
validation.assetDigestsAndLfsRules: Passed for all 26 new records and all 20 PNG files
validation.repositoryAudit: Full verify_assets.py does not pass in the current unstaged working tree. Its tracked-file inventory differs from the manifest for these new assets and pre-existing pending Kaijugen, village, Heartleaf logo and rooted icon changes. No files were staged.

usage.height: Opaque linear grayscale artist-inferred relief, white higher; use as data rather than sRGB
usage.repeat: Each tile repeats with itself; blend different variants using terrain weights
usage.scope: Nine repeating terrain pairs and nine matching RGBA splat pairs
